reason: Second write path would duplicate validation; the Pull-outs tab was the obvious but wrong place to look.
text: Commissary entries reuse the cashier withdrawals endpoint (POST /api/v1/cashier/ledger/withdrawals, handler apiSaveCashierWithdrawals) rather than adding a second ledger write path; the recorded entries surface on /admin/withdrawals, NOT on the commissary Pull-outs tab, which lists deliveries FROM branches.
